commands.name: token set
commands.description: Store the Alpaca API token (kept secret, used for all requests)
commands.script: function run(ctx) ctx.package.set_state('token', ctx.args.token) return {output='Token stored.'} end

commands.name: portfolio list
commands.script: function run(ctx) local rows = ctx.request.json or {} local out = {} for _,p in ipairs(rows) do table.insert(out, p.symbol..' '..p.qty..' @ '..tostring(p.avg_entry_price)) end return {output=#out..' positions', data=rows} end
